full_name: Tera W. Hunter | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2005–2006 History Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow Carnegie Mellon University
bio: Tera W. Hunter is an associate professor of history at Carnegie Mellon University, where she teaches courses in US history, specifically focused on African Americans, gender, labor, and Southern history.
